title: doc2vec
text: textmodel_doc2vec() supports dm (distributed memory) dbow (distributed bag--words) models. Since distributed memory model hidden layers documents words, can extract document word vectors using .matrix()
code: # Set the number of processors options(wordvector_threads = 16)  # Train doc2vec dov <- textmodel_doc2vec(toks, dim = 50, type = "dm", min_count = 5, verbose = TRUE) ## Training distributed memory model with 50 dimensions ##  ...using 16 threads for distributed computing ##  ...initializing ##  ...negative sampling in 10 iterations ##  ......iteration 1 elapsed time: 5.65 seconds (alpha: 0.0450) ##  ......iteration 2 elapsed time: 11.41 seconds (alpha: 0.0398) ##  ......iteration 3 elapsed time: 16.94 seconds (alpha: 0.0347) ##  ......iteration 4 elapsed time: 22.50 seconds (alpha: 0.0296) ##  ......iteration 5 elapsed time: 28.06 seconds (alpha: 0.0245) ##  ......iteration 6 elapsed time: 33.70 seconds (alpha: 0.0194) ##  ......iteration 7 elapsed time: 38.74 seconds (alpha: 0.0148) ##  ......iteration 8 elapsed time: 42.21 seconds (alpha: 0.0117) ##  ......iteration 9 elapsed time: 45.19 seconds (alpha: 0.0091) ##  ......iteration 10 elapsed time: 48.04 seconds (alpha: 0.0067) ##  ...complete # Extract document vector dim(as.matrix(dov, layer = "documents")) ## [1] 656334     50  # Extract word vector dim(as.matrix(dov, layer = "words")) ## [1] 79259    50

title: word2vec
text: similarity() user-friendly utility function find similar words. Using analogy() wrapper, can also add subtract word vectors finding similar words.
code: head(similarity(wov, "bad")) ##      bad       ## [1,] "bad"     ## [2,] "good"    ## [3,] "trouble" ## [4,] "worse"   ## [5,] "hard"    ## [6,] "scary" head(similarity(wov, analogy(~ good - bad))) ##      [,1]         ## [1,] "courageous" ## [2,] "thank"      ## [3,] "seniority"  ## [4,] "enthused"   ## [5,] "reaffirm"   ## [6,] "reaffirmed"

title: Word and Document Vector Models
text: similarity() computes cosine similarity word vectors.
code: head(similarity(wov, c("amazon", "forests", "obama", "america", "afghanistan"),                  mode = "character")) ##      amazon       forests      obama     america           afghanistan   ## [1,] "amazon"     "forests"    "obama"   "america"         "afghanistan" ## [2,] "peatlands"  "herds"      "barack"  "dakota"          "afghan"      ## [3,] "rainforest" "rainforest" "biden"   "american"        "kabul"       ## [4,] "soy"        "farmland"   "kerry"   "carolina"        "taliban"     ## [5,] "zijin"      "grasslands" "hagel"   "africa"          "pakistan"    ## [6,] "warm-water" "forest"     "clinton" "america-focused" "afghans"

title: Word and Document Vector Models
text: analogy() offers interface arithmetic operations word vectors. examples replicates analogical tasks original word2vec paper.
code: # What is Amazon without forests? head(similarity(wov, analogy(~ amazon - forests)))  ##      [,1]           ## [1,] "smash-hit"    ## [2,] "activision"   ## [3,] "iovine"       ## [4,] "nbcuniversal" ## [5,] "telephony"    ## [6,] "pandora" # What is for Afghanistan as Obama for America?  head(similarity(wov, analogy(~ obama - america + afghanistan)))  ##      [,1]          ## [1,] "afghanistan" ## [2,] "taliban"     ## [3,] "afghan"      ## [4,] "karzai"      ## [5,] "obama"       ## [6,] "nato" # What is for France as Berlin for Germany? head(similarity(wov, analogy(~ berlin - germany + france)))  ##      [,1]       ## [1,] "paris"    ## [2,] "berlin"   ## [3,] "brussels" ## [4,] "london"   ## [5,] "france"   ## [6,] "kourou" # What is for slowly as quick for quickly? head(similarity(wov, analogy(~ quick - quickly + slowly))) ##      [,1]                    ## [1,] "fades"                 ## [2,] "pitching"              ## [3,] "uneven"                ## [4,] "earlier-than-expected" ## [5,] "sideways"              ## [6,] "bumpy"

code: # \donttest{ library(quanteda) library(wordvector)  # pre-processing corp <- data_corpus_news2014  toks <- tokens(corp, remove_punct = TRUE, remove_symbols = TRUE) %>%     tokens_remove(stopwords("en", "marimo"), padding = TRUE) %>%     tokens_select("^[a-zA-Z-]+$", valuetype = "regex", case_insensitive = FALSE,                  padding = TRUE) %>%     tokens_tolower()  # train word2vec wov <- textmodel_word2vec(toks, dim = 50, type = "cbow", min_count = 5, sample = 0.001)  # find similar words head(similarity(wov, c("berlin", "germany", "france"), mode = "words")) #>      berlin      germany        france    #> [1,] "berlin"    "germany"      "france"  #> [2,] "frankfurt" "frankfurt"    "paris"   #> [3,] "german"    "hamburg"      "germany" #> [4,] "germany"   "braunschweig" "araud"   #> [5,] "amsterdam" "cologne"      "french"  #> [6,] "warsaw"    "eintracht"    "sweden"  head(similarity(wov, c("berlin" = 1, "germany" = -1, "france" = 1), mode = "values")) #>                  [,1] #> somali     0.07560527 #> reporters  0.05722617 #> released   0.05035426 #> bail       0.07020498 #> still     -0.11542090 #> jailed    -0.01876965 head(similarity(wov, analogy(~ berlin - germany + france), mode = "words")) #>      [,1]        #> [1,] "paris"     #> [2,] "france"    #> [3,] "berlin"    #> [4,] "french"    #> [5,] "brussels"  #> [6,] "amsterdam" # }
